title: OpenAI() raises "unexpected keyword argument 'proxies'" on a fresh install
symptoms: TypeError: Client.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'proxies'
TypeError: AsyncClient.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'proxies'
cause: httpx 0.28.0 removed the proxies argument that openai-python passed to it until 1.55.3. Pinned old SDK versions pull the newest httpx and fail at client creation.
fix: Upgrade openai to 1.55.3 or later, or pin httpx below 0.28.
affected: openai-python earlier than 1.55.3 with httpx 0.28.0 or later, since 2024-11-28
